_comment: Reference only. This is the exact shape merge-settings.py inserts into the user's real ~/.claude/settings.json (paths shown with $HOME; the real merge writes absolute paths). It is not applied automatically from this file — merge-settings.py performs a structural merge that preserves every other hook already present (e.g. an existing Stop hook). sync-sessions.sh detaches itself after reading the hook JSON from stdin, so it must NOT be wrapped in `nohup ... &`.

hooks.description: Background: map current project into ~/.claude-memory and sync (non-blocking)
